old: Secret agents close to the king and to the king's favourites should tell, with the confidence of a friend, those who stand as friends to the chiefs of the infantry, cavalry, chariots and elephants: "The king is angry."

why: reviewer (error): patty-aśva-ratha-dvipa-mukhyānām is a partitive genitive governed by mitra-sthānīyeṣu ('those among the chiefs who are in the position of friends', i.e. chiefs on friendly terms with the agents), not 'friends of the chiefs'. 12.3.4 ('this is what we told you', said to the surviving chiefs) confirms the chiefs themselves are told.
